correctness.rationale: I reconstructed the cover and the lifts. The valuation 1 at u=0 proves degree m by Eisenstein, and k contains the m-th roots of unity. The simple roots of (u^(q²)−u)/(u^q−u) are precisely F_(q²) outside F_q; deg f=q^n gives the infinity label 1 modulo m. If d divides r and m, then q^(n−1)=1 and q^n=−1 modulo d, so q=−1 and the odd-length geometric sum r is 1 modulo d; hence d=1. For n≥4 the two exponents 1 and r are distinct modulo m. A normalizer preserves the fixed field and must send z to h(u)z^t by the deck eigenspaces, with t a unit mod m. Taking valuations of f(M(u))=h(u)^m f(u)^t shows that t permutes the labels. A swap would exchange classes of unequal sizes q+1 and q²−q (also unequal at q=2), so t=1 and the classes are preserved. The stabilizer of P¹(F_q) is PGL₂(q), by the action on three distinct points. Independently, for matrices over F_q, M(u)^(q^i)−M(u)=det(M)(u^(q^i)−u)/(γu+δ)^(q^i+1), for i=1,2, giving f(M(u))/f(u)=det(M)/(γu+δ)^m. The norm from k to F_(q^n) supplies all determinant roots λ. The kernel is exactly the m deck transformations; they commute with every lift. The quotient PGL₂(q) has trivial center: a central element must preserve the unique fixed point of each point stabilizer and so fixes all points. This proves the stated center and order. The same label argument works after base change, and all lifts are already defined over k. For n=2 the labels coincide; the proof requires even n≥4 and does not determine the full even-n automorphism group.
residual_risks: No claim that the distinguished cyclic group is normal in the full group.

evidence: Hidalgo–Quispe–Shaska use exponents on normalizer orbits to detect centrality over complex Riemann surfaces. Beelen–Montanucci determine the full automorphism group in the odd-n family (n≥5). The Chebyshev–Kummer theorem assumes a different defining polynomial and p not dividing 2nm in its notation.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The parity-distinct full-group theorem does not dominate the target parameters, and the characteristic-zero and Chebyshev–Kummer hypotheses do not specialize to the even Ma–Wang model. In particular the target polynomial degree q^n is divisible by the characteristic.

The substantive family-specific comparison is the exhaustion argument, not the standard machinery or a restatement of the previously known subgroup order.

value.rationale: The result closes the natural quotient-preserving portion of the even-family automorphism problem. In particular, the known subgroup is maximal among automorphisms preserving the specified Kummer structure, and any extra automorphism must move the deck group. This eliminates a plausible source of extra automorphisms, including at small q, without conflating the stabilizer with the full group.
residual_risks: Does not classify conjugates of C or rule out additional full automorphisms.
